    read -r pid expected <<< "$spec"
    if [[ -r /proc/$pid/cmdline ]]; then
        command=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline)
        [[ $command == *"$expected"* ]]
        group=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$pid" | tr -d ' ')
        [[ $group == "$pid" ]]
        printf 'Owned failed fixture cleanup: pid=%s pgid=%s cmd=%s\n' "$pid" "$group" "$command"
        kill -KILL -- "-$group"
    fi
done

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
if [[ ${1:-} != --inside ]]; then
    exec unshare --mount --fork bash "$0" --inside "$@"
fi
shift
repo=/mnt/c/Users/mrkda/Projects/shark
root=/var/tmp/shark-graphics-02d-20261018/build-root
mount --make-rprivate /
mount -t proc proc "$root/proc"
mount -t tmpfs tmpfs "$root/dev"
for spec in 'null 1 3' 'zero 1 5' 'random 1 8' 'urandom 1 9'; do
    read -r name major minor <<< "$spec"
    mknod -m 666 "$root/dev/$name" c "$major" "$minor"
done
mkdir -p "$root/dev/pts"
mount -t devpts devpts "$root/dev/pts"
ln -s pts/ptmx "$root/dev/ptmx"
ln -s /proc/self/fd "$root/dev/fd"
mount --bind "$repo" "$root/source"
mount -o remount,bind,ro "$root/source"
mount --bind "$root/work/build" "$root/source/build"
mount --bind "$root/work/graphics-cache" "$root/source/.tools/graphics"
mount --bind "$repo/out" "$root/source/out"
exec chroot "$root" /usr/bin/env -i PATH=/opt/shark-headless/venv/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin HOME=/root CC=/usr/bin/gcc-13 CXX=/usr/bin/g++-13 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/source /bin/bash -c 'cd /source; exec "$@"' bash "$@"
